scenario_scope: Intake of Bennett's The Optimal Choice of Hypothesis Is the Weakest, Not the Shortest as a conditional learning-theory comparator to MDL and compression-based generalization claims.

cases.decision_rationale: The existing chapter already owns generalization assumptions, inductive-bias lenses, compression/MDL limits, task distributions, and forecast validity. The paper adds a direct conditional comparator and counterexample without introducing a distinct architecture owner.
required_before_drafting: explicit uniform-task and finite-language assumption record
evidence_transition_preconditions: formal reproduction or exact finite check
promotion_blockers: no modern neural or safety result
non_claims: does not establish weakness as a universal learning objective
does not refute all MDL or compression-based methods
does not promote the chapter core

cases.decision_rationale: The source supplies one formal lens and one narrow experiment family. It does not own a distinct interface, lifecycle, invariant family, or artifact type beyond the existing Learning Theory chapter.
required_before_drafting: not applicable; integrate through the existing owner
evidence_transition_preconditions: a future distinct operational lifecycle would require fresh chapter-boundary adjudication
promotion_blockers: topic novelty is not an architectural boundary
non_claims: does not reserve or defer a future standalone chapter

validation_boundary: Records a source-note-backed existing-chapter integration and rejects a duplicate chapter. It does not validate the paper's proof, reproduce its experiments, establish a universal inductive bias, or promote support.
non_claims: does not add a proof target by itself
does not authorize an experiment, release, deployment, or publication
